children: China auto dealer's interim revenue for six months to June 2026 rose 1% yr/yr
Company posted net loss attributable of RMB101.5 mln, reversing prior period profit
Automobile sales revenue declined 4.1%, after-sales services revenue grew 26.1%
Company did not provide specific guidance or outlook for future periods
AFTER-SALES SERVICES - Revenue from after-sales services rose 26.1% yr/yr on higher business volume, helping offset weaker automobile sales
WEAKER AUTO SALES - Automobile revenue fell 4.1% as average selling prices dropped 13.7% amid weak consumer sentiment
COMMISSION INCOME DECLINE – Other income fell 81.0%, mainly due to lower commission income from value-added automobile services
The stock recently traded at 1 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 1 three months ago
